about: The idol opening, 'Sloppy Stage': ninety seconds upright (9:16), three takes of thirty seconds that are three scenes (backstage and the entrance; the performance and the five's introductions; the finale and after), made on MAGI-2 through Higgsfield by hand, once upright and once wide (16:9), from the prompts and pictures in dist/cutscenes/idol/magi-9x16 and magi-16x9; the takes are named A-9x16-....mp4 and A-16x9-....mp4, and 'make_cutscene.py idol --edit --with 9x16' (or 16x9) joins them. Names and the title are put on by tools/make_cutscene.py.

wear.H: Halgakos: long pink hair, pink cat ears, two dark curled horns, one white feathered wing and one black bat wing, a pink cat tail; her stage costume is a black and pink frilled idol dress to the knee with white bows and a pink ribbon at the collar, black stockings
wear.C: Chikuwa: brown hair in two long tails; her stage costume is a red and white idol dress to the knee with white fur trim and a little red Santa cap, white gloves and stockings
wear.R: Rune: very long pale blue hair in two low tails; her stage costume is a blue and black idol jacket-dress to the knee with a blue ribbon tie, dark stockings
wear.I: Illya: very long peach-blond hair with white ribbons; her stage costume is a gold and pink magical idol dress to the knee with a white frilled skirt, long white gloves, pink boots
wear.T: Tsubakieh: short purple-grey hair with one curl standing up, round dot eyes and a calm blank face; her stage costume is a purple and cream sailor-collar idol dress to the knee with a purple ribbon, black tights, and a white baseball bat she carries like a penlight

look: 2D anime idol concert, cel shading, bright stage lights. No text.
music: Music: bright, bouncy idol pop, 120 bpm, handclaps, synths, crowd calls.
voice: Cute, high, light girls' singing voices.

shots.name: A1
shots.frame: Backstage, warm bulbs round a dressing-room mirror. Halgakos, full figure in the middle, in her stage costume, licks the last of a cone of pale green mint chocolate-chip ice cream with a smug half-lidded look, a microphone waiting on the table beside her.
shots.short: {H} finishes her mint ice cream with a smug look, sets the cone down and picks up her microphone.
shots.heard: muffled crowd, a bass thump through the wall.
shots.sung by: the crowd, off screen, chants
shots.lyric: Squish! Sloppy~! Squish! Sloppy~!

shots.name: A2
shots.frame: A dark backstage corridor seen from behind: the five walk away from the viewer in a row toward a bright doorway of stage light at the end, Halgakos in the middle, their figures rimmed with light.
shots.short: The five walk down the dark corridor toward the bright doorway of the stage, seen from behind; {H} in the middle twirls her microphone.
shots.sung by: the crowd, off screen, chants
shots.lyric: Squish! Sloppy~! Squish! Sloppy~!

shots.name: A3
shots.frame: A dark concert hall seen from the back over the heads of a crowd of small cute creatures shaped like numerals and plus signs with tiny legs and round eyes, each waving a glowing penlight (pink, red, blue, gold or purple); far ahead on the stage a giant closed green book with gold corners stands under one spotlight.
shots.short: The little numerals wave their penlights in time, a sea of five colours; on the stage the giant green book stands closed under a spotlight.
shots.heard: a roaring crowd, claps in time.
shots.sung by: five girls' voices, off screen, sing together
shots.lyric: Lights go up, the pages fly, five of us beneath the sky;

shots.name: A4
shots.frame: The stage: the giant green book has just swung open and light floods up out of it; loose pages burst upward like confetti; five dark silhouettes of the girls rise on a lift in the middle of the book, backlit.
shots.short: The giant book swings open, pages burst up like confetti, light floods the stage and the five rise as silhouettes on a lift.
shots.heard: a big whoosh, a cymbal crash, cheers.
shots.sung by: five girls' voices sing together
shots.lyric: open the book, the story's ours, sing it loud and light the stars!

shots.name: A5
shots.frame: A concert stage that is a giant open green book with gold corners: its pages are the floor and the tall glowing screen behind. Spotlights snap on: the five stand in their opening pose, full figures, Halgakos in the centre with her microphone raised and a wink, Chikuwa and Illya to her left, Rune and Tsubakieh to her right, pages drifting down.
shots.short: Spotlights snap on over the five in their opening pose; {H} in the centre winks and raises her microphone, singing.
shots.sung by: {H} sings, her mouth moving with the song
shots.lyric: Hands up high, penlights bright,

shots.name: A6
shots.frame: A concert stage that is a giant open green book with gold corners: its pages are the floor and the tall glowing screen behind, seen full height from the hall. The five dance in a row, full figures from head to shoes, all in the same step: right arm up with the microphone, left hand on the hip, one knee lifted.
shots.short: The five dance in a row in perfect unison, full figures: a step to the side, an arm up, a turn; all five sing, their mouths moving with the song.
shots.sung by: all five sing together, their mouths moving with the song
shots.lyric: call my name and call it right!

shots.name: A7
shots.frame: Close on Halgakos from the waist up on the stage, pink light, leaning toward the viewer with a smug grin, holding her microphone out toward the crowd; penlights glow out of focus in front of her.
shots.short: {H} shouts the call into her microphone and thrusts it toward the crowd, who shout the answer; she does it twice, cups a hand to her ear, then grins, smug.
shots.sung by: {H} calls and the crowd answers
shots.lyric: Squish! (Sloppy~!) Squish! (Sloppy~!) Louder!

shots.name: B1
shots.frame: A concert stage that is a giant open green book with gold corners: its pages are the floor and the tall glowing screen behind, the screen behind blazing pink. The five dance side by side, full figures, mid-step: both hands making a squashing clap in front of them, big smiles, Halgakos in the centre.
shots.short: The five dance the chorus side by side, full figures: a squashing clap on each call, a hop, a spin; all five sing, their mouths moving with the song.
shots.sung by: all five sing together, their mouths moving with the song
shots.lyric: Squish, Sloppy~ we're on tonight! Squish, Sloppy~ five colours of light!

shots.name: B2
shots.frame: The hall from the stage: a crowd of small cute creatures shaped like numerals and plus signs with tiny legs and round eyes, each waving a glowing penlight (pink, red, blue, gold or purple), packed to the back, penlights raised, mouths open in a cheer; pages drift down over them.
shots.short: The little numerals jump in time and thrust their penlights up on every call, shouting along.
shots.heard: a crowd shouting in time, claps.
shots.sung by: the five, off screen, and the crowd sing together
shots.lyric: Every heart, every page, every beat, Squish, Sloppy~ get up on your feet!

shots.name: B3
shots.frame: Close on Halgakos from the chest up, pink spotlight, a smug half-lidded look and a small fanged smile, making a heart with the fingers of one hand beside her cheek, microphone in the other. The lower third of the picture is calm.
shots.short: {H} sings her own introduction into her microphone with a smug half-lidded look, makes a finger heart and winks.
shots.heard: the crowd answers with a shout.
shots.sung by: {H} sings, her mouth moving with the song; the crowd shouts back
shots.lyric: Pink in the centre, smug as can be: Halgakos! (Sloppy~!)

shots.name: B4
shots.frame: Chikuwa from the knees up, red spotlight, beaming, microphone in one hand, tossing a golden bread roll from a little basket on her arm toward the viewer. The lower third of the picture is calm.
shots.short: {C} sings her introduction, beaming, and tosses bread rolls from her basket to the crowd.
shots.sung by: {C} sings, her mouth moving with the song; the crowd shouts back
shots.lyric: Red as a ribbon, warm as bread: Chikuwa! (Chikuwa!)

shots.name: B5

card.name: Rune
card.says: Blue. Cries on the high notes.

shots.frame: Rune from the knees up, blue spotlight, a shy little wave, one tear on her cheek and a brave smile, microphone held in both hands; small drops of ink float around her turning into blue sparkles. The lower third of the picture is calm.
shots.short: {R} sings her introduction shyly, waves, and one tear rolls down as she smiles; drops of ink around her turn into blue sparkles.
shots.sung by: {R} sings, her mouth moving with the song; the crowd shouts back
shots.lyric: Blue as the ink and the tears I've shed: Rune! (Rune!)

shots.name: B6
shots.frame: Illya, full figure, gold spotlight, mid-twirl with her hair flying, a feather-quill microphone raised, a wink; gold sparkles spiral round her. The lower third of the picture is calm.
shots.short: {I} sings her introduction, twirls once with her quill microphone and lands in a pose with a wink, gold sparkles spiralling.
shots.sung by: {I} sings, her mouth moving with the song; the crowd shouts back
shots.lyric: Gold in the spotlight, born to lead: Illya! (Illya!)

shots.name: B7
shots.frame: Tsubakieh from the knees up, purple spotlight, perfectly blank-faced with round dot eyes, in a flawless idol pose: one hand up in a V sign by her eye, the white bat held in the other like a penlight. The lower third of the picture is calm.
shots.short: {T} sings her introduction with a perfectly blank face, swings her bat once like a penlight in time, then holds a flawless idol pose with a tiny V sign.
shots.heard: the crowd shouts her name, a swish.
shots.sung by: {T} sings, her mouth moving with the song; the crowd shouts back
shots.lyric: Purple and calm, I swing, I speed: Tsubakieh! (Tsubakieh!)

shots.name: C1
shots.frame: A runway running out from the stage into the hall, seen from the front: the five run toward the viewer along it hand in hand, full figures, laughing, a crowd of small cute creatures shaped like numerals and plus signs with tiny legs and round eyes, each waving a glowing penlight (pink, red, blue, gold or purple) on both sides.
shots.short: The five run down the runway into the hall hand in hand, toward the camera, singing; penlights wave on both sides.
shots.sung by: all five sing together, their mouths moving with the song
shots.lyric: Down the runway, hand in hand,

shots.name: C2
shots.frame: Low angle from the foot of the runway looking up: the five in a V formation, full figures, Halgakos at the point, all with one arm thrown up, pages falling like confetti against the lights.
shots.short: Low angle: the five dance in a V formation, arms sweeping up together, pages falling like confetti; all five sing.
shots.sung by: all five sing together, their mouths moving with the song
shots.lyric: every voice in storybook land;

shots.name: C3
shots.frame: Close on Halgakos from the shoulders up, pink light, looking at the viewer over her microphone with a smug half-lidded look and a small fanged smile, one brow raised.
shots.short: {H} looks the viewer up and down over her microphone, smug, sings her line with a small nod, and flicks her hair back.
shots.sung by: {H} sings, her mouth moving with the song
shots.lyric: not bad, for you, you kept the beat, one more time, up on your feet!

shots.name: C4
shots.frame: A concert stage that is a giant open green book with gold corners: its pages are the floor and the tall glowing screen behind. All five in mid-jump together, full figures, arms and microphones thrown up, pages bursting above them like fireworks in five colours.
shots.short: All five jump together, arms up, and pages burst above them like fireworks; all five sing.
shots.heard: a boom of fireworks, a roar.
shots.sung by: all five sing together, their mouths moving with the song
shots.lyric: Squish, Sloppy~ we're on tonight! Squish, Sloppy~ five colours of light!

shots.name: C5
shots.frame: The hall from high above: the crowd's penlights have gathered into one great heart of five colours, pink in the middle; the stage glows at the top of the picture.
shots.short: From above, the crowd's penlights sway and form one great heart in five colours.
shots.sung by: the five, off screen, and the crowd sing together
shots.lyric: Every heart, every page, every beat,

shots.name: C6
shots.frame: A concert stage that is a giant open green book with gold corners: its pages are the floor and the tall glowing screen behind. The five stand in a line at the front of the stage, full figures, hands joined and raised, Halgakos in the centre, smiling out at the hall.
shots.short: The five stand in a line with joined hands raised, sing the last line, and bow deeply together.
shots.sung by: all five sing together, their mouths moving with the song
shots.lyric: Squish, Sloppy~ encore, repeat!

shots.name: C7
shots.frame: Backstage after the show, warm light, in the lower two thirds of the picture: Halgakos flopped on a sofa, tired and content, holding a big cone of pale green mint chocolate-chip ice cream; Chikuwa, Rune, Illya and Tsubakieh around her, laughing. The upper third of the picture is a plain dark wall with soft lights and nothing else on it.
shots.short: After the show {H} flops on the sofa with a big mint ice cream and takes a blissful lick; the others laugh around her; she says her last line toward the viewer with a tired smug smile.
shots.sung by: {H} says, not singing, her mouth moving
shots.lyric: Thank you! Now where is my mint ice cream? Sloppy~
